speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Japan's GT Championship in the late 1990s was a three-way battle
between the Nissan Skyline, Honda NSX and the Toyota Supra.

The battles amongst Japan's three major car manufacturers
was one for the ages!

By the final round, which was run in the pouring rain,
all three teams were still in contention for the title.

Even after the checkered flag was waved, it wasn't
certain who had wo the series.

That's because two teams were tied for the top spot, and
their 2nd-place finishes were also even.

This meant the tiebreaker came down to the number of 3rd-place
finishes they had recorded over the seson...

In the end, the Tom's Supra Numb 36 came out
 top n the historic 1997 season.
zh:
二十世纪九十年代末，日本房车锦标赛呈现的是三足鼎立
的态势：日产天际线、本田NSX和丰田Supra。

这辆Tom's Supra在1997年夺冠的那一役，
堪称一场真正的悬念大戏！

战至大雨滂沱的最后一轮比赛中，
竟仍有4支车队保有夺冠可能！

甚至在方格旗落下之后，冠军归属仍然扑朔迷离。

因为有两支车队积分持平、并列第一，就连他们在赛季中获得亚军
的次数也完全相同。

最后为了决定胜负，竟要追溯这两支车队
在整个赛季中获得季军的次数！

而这辆36号Tom's Supra正是从那场扣人心弦~
1997年冠lq决q中脱颖而出的最终王者！

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
Are you familiar with the term "muscle car?"

They were large American machines from the 1960s known for
their large displacement and enormous power.

The first-generation Camaro Z28 was one of the more notable
models from that era.

Its V-8 engine was developed especially for the Trans Am racing
series, meaning it was highly potent.

Instead having tons of torque like other large-displacement
engines, it offered plenty of top-end power.

With awesome straight-line speed, the race version of the
Z28 took home several victories in Trans-Am races.

Known as the last of the Z28s, this 1969 model has been
covetedfor generations.
zh:
你熟悉“肌肉车”吗？

这类车以其大排量和强劲动力而闻名，
是60年代美国跑车文化的典型特征。

第一代Camaro Z28就是在该文化浪潮中诞生的传奇车型之一……

但其专为Trans Am系列赛研发的
V8引擎，也同样令人惊叹。

不像大部分的大排量引擎那样强调扭矩，
而是主打高转速。

不但能在日常行驶中派上用场，还是让Camaro Z28
在Trans Am竞赛获胜的幕后功臣。

这款1969年车型是Z28最后的改款，
其每代车款都令人着迷不已。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
Of all the Nissan Skyline GT-Rs, this R32 stands out
as truly special.

From the late 1960s to the early 1970s, the Skyline seemed
unstoppable on the Japanese race circuit.

However, Nissan halted production of the Skyline GT-R
in response to the 1973 oil crisis.

In 1989, the GT-R name was revived with this
R32 Skyline GT-R.

Nissan poured all of its technical kno-how into
its development.

The hard work paid off, as the R32 dominated the competition
from the get-go, winning the hearts of motorsport fans.

I can only imagine that its value will continue to increase
over time.
zh:
在日产Skyline GT-R系列车型中，这款R32
脱颖而出，成为一代变革之作！

从20世纪60年代末到70年代初，Skyline在日本赛道上
大杀四方，几乎势不可挡。

然而，为应对1973年的石油危机，日产中断了
该车型的生产。

1989年，GT-R这个代号因这款R32 Skyline GT-R车型
而再次响亮于赛场之上。

日产在研发这款车型时倾注了其
所有的技术积累。

辛勤努力最终有了回报，R32一出现就称霸了
整个赛场，赢得了众多赛车铁杆粉的青睐。

我推测，随着时间的累积
这款车将持续升值。

Ever wanted to play around with a big naturally-aspirated
engine on a manual gearbox?

Well, you can with the Z33—which is one of its main
selling points.

This late model from 2007 is equipped with a VQ35HR engine,
which boasts a higher redline than the standard model.

The way it vastly improves upon a sensation so unique to
naturally-aspirated engines is truly astounding.

These cars are reasonably priced when bought used.
In any case, it’s a really great car.
Q
zh:
有没有想过用手动变速箱操纵一台
大排量自然吸气引擎？

唔，你可以试下以此为卖点的这款Z33。

这款2007年晚期的车型搭载VQ35HR引擎，

Although Mitsubishi has not competed in a

可以保证，这款车型将来
在国际场上的价值只会越来越高。

打造其他F1比赛的车型……

不容小觑。

这具引擎是如此轻巧。

确实，单纯就冲那引擎，
这款突破想象的车型就值得拥有！

The Alfa Romeo 4C is a car with plenty of charm.

weighing a mere <895kg>!

This is rather astounding when one considers the design
trends of the 2010s.

Its innovative carbon-fiber body really

Moreover, its mid-engine sports car proportions
made it a sight to behold.

It even pays homage to Alfa Romeo's historic

对轻量化有极大帮助。

虽然只搭载了1.8L涡轮引擎，但轻盈的车身
让这辆车能飙出超跑的速度。

此外，中置引擎的跑车设计
确实令人耳目一新。

这样的设计，是在向Alfa Romeo史上具有
非凡意义的Tipo 33 Stradale致敬。

en:
This car is one of the most legendary creations
in Alfa Romeo's storied history.

Alfa Romeo was once a purveyor of the world's foremost
race cars and premium GT vehicles.

What we have here is a modern rendition of the cars
from that period.

From its name to its styling, it conjures up memories
of the company as it was in the 1930s and 1940s.

Although it employs a FR drive system, the transmission
has been mounted at the rear.

The transaxle assembly was meant to improve
weight distribution.

While the name and legacy are enough to give you chills,
wait until you get behind the heel and drive it!
zh:
这款车是Alfa Romeo史上最富传奇色彩的作品之一。

Alfa Romeo曾专注于制造赛车和高级GT车型。

这款车则是用现代手法
来演绎那段时期的代表之作。

这款车从称谓到款式，无一不唤起人们对
Alfa Romemo在20世纪30和40年代的记忆。

虽然采用前置后驱系统，
不过变速器却置于后方……

采用跨轴布局，目的是改善重量分布。

不仅在称谓和外观上令人振奋，
这款车的驾驭感受也非常梦幻！

Now, this is a true icon! A modern take
on the Ford GT40 of Le Mans fame.

It was built to commemorate Ford's 100th anniversary.

In terms of design, it conjured up memories of the beautiful
race cars that played a big role at Le Mans in the 1960s.

Under the sheet metal, however, it was completely revamped,
with an innovative aluminum space frame.

Also, in a brilliant move, it combined a supercharged
mid-mounted V8 engine...

...with a 6-speed manual gearbox.

Honestly, I can't imagine the value of this beauty
ever going down.
zh:
现在这款车可以说是真的经典！
因勒芒耐力赛而闻名的现代版Ford GT40……

为庆祝Ford成立100周年而制造。

从设计上来看，令人回忆起那些在20世纪60年代
大放异彩的赛车。

至于内装，则完全改头换面，
采用全新研发的铝制空间车架。

这款车另一项高明的设计是搭载
中置V8机械增压引擎……

并配备六速手动变速箱。

坦白说，我觉得这款尤物的价值
不可能下降。

One design objective was to optimize it for off-road racing,

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
This car taught the world the true meaning of "Turbo".
Even today it is often referred to as simply "Turbo."

Porsche poured all of its the engineering expertise into the
turbocharger that powered this Type 930 911.

Compared to the 1978 model, the flat-6 engine had more
displacement, at 3.3 liters, and an output of <300ps>.

Because the 911 is a rear-engine car, more load is placed on
the rear tires giving it superior traction.

Add to this a turbocharger, and you've got a machine that
can really get up and go!

This 930 holds its own among Porsche's many masterpieces
and belongs in every enthusiast's collection.
zh:
这辆车让世界领教到了“涡轮”的真正含义。
即使在今天，这辆车也会经常被提起。

Porsche汇集了他们所有的涡轮设计经验，

role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
This is the road version of the Mark I that raced at Le Mans
in 1966.

The Ford GT40 Mk I was introduced in 1964.

It was developed specifically to beat Ferrari at Le Mans,
where the Italian company had dominated.

Three Mk Is participated in the 1964 Le Mans race, but they all
retired without making it to the finish line.

In 1965, Ford put Carroll Shelby in charge of everything
from development to strategy, with thesame result...

Then, Shelby completely overhauled the chassis and engine,
creating the Mk II in 1966.

Eight Mk IIs and five Mk Is waged war at Le Mans
that year.

It was an overwhelmin show of strength in numbers!

This determination brought home the Le Ms title for Fo,
fnally putting an end to Ferrari's run.
zh:
这辆车是参加了1966年勒芒耐力赛的Mark 1的公路版。

福特GT40 Mark 1公布于1964年。

这辆车是专门为了超越当时称霸勒芒的法拉利而开发的。

1964年，有三辆Mark 1参加了勒芒耐力赛，但全部中途退赛了。

1965年，福特任命卡罗尔·谢尔比负责从开发到战略的一切工作，
但比赛结果还是一样……

1966'，对底盘和发动机进行了完全改造的Mark II开发完成。

一共八辆Mark II和五辆Mark I参加了当年的勒芒耐力赛。

那可是压倒性的数量优势！

因此，福特也毫无意外地A那年首次夺得了勒芒耐力赛冠军宝座！

role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The 1988 24 Hours of Le Mans was one for the history books.

Jaguar fans from the UK were showed up in force, with Union Jack
flags waving all around the track.

It was a sight I'll never forget.

This is the car that brought Jaguar the victory that day.

It finally got the better of the Porsches that had
dominated Le Mans for so long.

It certainly put a smile on the legions of Britsh fans.

But they first had to endure a stressful race.

It wasn't until the end that Jaguar was able to put away
the Porsche that was applying pressure all race.

Just thinking of it now sends  chill down my spine.
V
zh:
1988年的勒芒24小时耐力赛相当不平凡。

那年，大批来自英国的Jaguar车迷涌入赛场，
赛道上的米字旗四处可见。

我永远也忘不了那番景象！

而那天为Jaguar赢得胜利的，正是这辆车……

他们在那天终于打败了称霸勒芒已久的Porsche。

这也让英国车迷充满了自豪和喜悦。

萨森赛车场那时热闹非凡！

那场比赛非常激烈，获胜的Jaguar到最后
都一直面临着身后Porsche的压力！

光是想想那场景就让我背脊发凉！

en:
The Stratos, designed by Marcello Gandini...

...was created to accomplish just one goal.

And what was that, you ask? To win rally races.

Legend has it that the car was a handful to drive
owing to its short wheelbase.

In fact, only a handful of drivers could ever really
master it.

One of them was the legendary rally driver
Sandro Munari.

He controlled the Stratos like it was a part of his body.

His view on the matter was:

"If you find driving this car difficult, then your skills
just aren't good enough."
zh:
Stratos的设计者是马塞罗·甘迪尼……

他设计这辆车的目的只有一个。

那个目的是？在拉力赛中获胜。

传说这辆车非常难驾驭……

实际上，真正驾驭了这辆车的人也就那么几名车手。

传奇拉力车手桑德罗·穆纳利便是这些车手之一。

对他来说，操纵Stratos就像是操纵玩具车那样易如反掌！

他对此的看法是：

“如果您觉得这车难开，那只能说明你还欠火候！”

en:
This is a McLaren F1 that has seen some track action.
Many consider this car to be the perfect sport car.

This race spec version first made an appearance in 1994.

And in 1995, it made its Le Mans debut,
going on to grab the overall title!

Incidentally, the victorious McLaren F1 GTR was once driven
by former Formula 1 driver JJ Lehto...

...and Japanese driver Masanori Sekiya.

It was the first time that a Japanese driver had won at
Le Mans.

He was also the fastest driver on the team, even when rain
fell during the night at the Circuit de la Sarthe.
zh:
一辆久经战阵的迈凯伦F1！这可能是
有史以来最接近“完美”的车子了……

这辆车的赛车版本在1994年首次出现……

并于1995年首次在勒芒参赛，然后赢得了比赛！

顺便一说，那辆获胜的迈凯伦F1 GTR是由前一级方程式车手J.J.莱赫托和……

日本车手关谷正德驾驶的。

那是日本车手首次在勒芒夺冠！

而且，在那个萨森赛车场的雨夜里，他是车队里最快的车手！

role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
This is a race car version of Mercedes-Benz's luxury sedan,
the 300 SEL.

The 300 SEL caught the eye of Mercedes-Benz tuner, AMG...

Who tweaked it to racing spec by increasing the engine
displacement to 6.8L.

It made its race debut in July 1971...

...in a European Touring Car Championship race at Spa-
Francorchamps in Belgium.

It won its class there, and finished in avery impressive
2nd place overall.

Pretty amazing for a large, 4-door sedan!

This result put AMG on the map, and gave it worldwide
prominence.

AMG would go on to play a key role in Mecedes-Benz's
race teams at the DTM and elsewhere.
zh:
这是梅赛德斯-奔驰的豪华轿车300 SEL的赛车版本。

梅赛德斯-奔驰的改装商AMG慧眼发掘了300 SEL。

AMG将其调整为赛车规格，引擎排量增加到了6.8升。

它于1971年7月首次在比赛中亮相……

在比利时斯帕弗朗科尔尚赛道举行的欧洲房车锦标赛中，

它不仅赢得了本级别的比赛，并获得了总绩第二名，
令人印象深刻。

对于一辆大型四门轿车来说，这是很了不起的成就。

这一成就也使AMG声名鹊起，并在全世界范围内为人所知。

在那之后，他们在梅赛德斯-奔驰旗下的各支赛车队伍中j
在包括德qW房O大师赛的各项赛事中发挥了关键作用。

role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Renault is a company that loves to compete.

It has been involved in many forms of motorsport,
including Formula 1.

It was also formidable in the rallying world, alongside
cars such as the Gordini and the Alpine from the 70s.

The 1980s, though, the company was all about this R5 Turbo.

One of its early drivers, Jean Ragnotti, mentioned that the
car suffered from terrible handling.

He also confessed that misjudgments on narrow roads would
always cause the rear of the car to hit objects.

This is because the rear of the R5 Turbo was wider than the
front.

It's amusing to hear easoned pros complain about aspects
of a car they don't like.
zh:
Renault是一家热爱竞技的公司。

他们会参与各项赛车运动，F1自然也在其列。

他们的拉力赛血统包括Gordini，以及1970年代的Alpine。

而到了20世纪80年代，主角就成了R5 Turbo。

作为早期驾驶者之一的让·拉格诺蒂提到过，车辆原本的
操控性非常糟糕。

他还坦言，在狭窄的道路上，车尾常常会因为车手的错
误判断而导致碰撞。

这是因为R5 Turbo的车尾比车头宽。

听到经验丰富的专业人员也会遇到这类问题，真是很有
意思！

en:
I was pretty surprised when I heard about the car Nissan
were entering into Le Mans in 2015!

This GT-R LM NISMO.

The designer, Ben Bowlby, opted for an FF layout, and worked
hard on the aerodynamics.

Unfortunately, however, these innovations didn't pay off.

In qualifying, the car was 20 seconds slower than its
fastest rival.

Worse still, in the race itself, two of three cars had to
retire, so only one was able to reach the finish line.

However, even this finisher didn't complete enough laps,
and was officially judged not to have finished!
E
zh:
听说Nissan要在2015年参加勒芒比赛时，我非常惊讶！

在这辆GT-R LM NISMO上，

设计师本·鲍尔比选择了前置前驱布局，并在空气动力学
方面下了很大功夫。

不幸的是，这些创新并没有得到回报。

When the Mini was born in 1959, it revolutionized the world
of compact front-wheel-drive cars.

Designed by the English engineer Alec Issigonis...

...it sported a uniquely positioned engine and gearbox.

This maximized the space-saving potential of its
front-wheel-drive layout.

The result was a small and fast car with a roomy interior.

The Mini's historic front-wheel drive layout is now
widely referred to as an "Issigonis" layout.

And why shouldn't it be? It was designed by the
brilliant engineer after all.

当MINI于1959年诞生时，它彻底改变了小型前轮驱动汽车的世界。

此车由英国工程师亚历克·伊斯戈尼斯设计……

它的引擎和变速箱安装的位置非常独特，

最大限度地发挥了前轮驱动布局节省空间的潜力。

因此造就了一辆小而快的汽车，具有宽敞的内部空间。

MINI的历史性前轮驱动布局现在被广泛称为“伊斯戈尼斯”布局。

这并不奇怪。毕竟它就是由这位杰出的工程师设计的！

Praising it for its precise handling and
smooth turning.

master, Seiji Ara.

role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
A Gran Turismo Championship icon
and the ultimate racing car.

Inaugural series champion Igor Fraga and
2019 champion, Mikail Hizal...

Raced this machine at the 2018 GTC finals in Monaco
to a near dead heat.

I’ll never forget the explosive energy in the venue
when the winner was announced!

The responsiveness of its 3L NA engine is incredible...

And its exhaust note is like music!

Because of its sharp handling, it requires
comprehensive driving skill to master.

But if you can tame this beast, you’re well on
your way to becoming Gran Turismo royalty!
~

米迦勒·希扎尔……

驾驶着这款比赛机器在摩纳哥举行的2018年总决赛中杀得
难解难分。

我永远不会忘记最后宣布冠军那一刻赛场里迸发的热烈
气氛！

3升自然进气引擎的响应速度十分傲人……

它的排气声响听起来也极其美妙！

灵敏的操控意味着你需要拥有全面的驾驶技术才能够驾
驭它。

如果你能够驯服这头猛兽，相信你的跑车浪漫旅比赛传奇之路
会一畅通！

role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Did you know that there is a full-scale paper model
of this EPSON NSX?

It's true. EPSON commissioned Japanese paper artist
Hitoshi Shinozaki to build one.

It’s entirely made of cardboard, including
the tires and all of the other intricate parts.

It looks like the real thing, as if it could
drive off at a moment’s notice.

But I digress.

The real NSX competed under EPSON colors
in Japnese GT races from 2004 to 2009.

At the time, the All Japan Grand Touring Championship
was evolving into the Super GT Series.

The EPSON NSX competed in the latter half of the 2008
season, where it came in 2nd place in ound 8 race.
z
zh:
你知道吗？这款ESPON NSX居然还有一套全尺寸的纸模呢。

这是真的，是Epson委托日本纸模艺术家筱崎仁帮他们打造的。

这个纸模全部由硬纸板做成，甚至连轮胎和其他的圆形
部件也不例外。

这个纸模看上去足以以假乱真，就好像可以随时上路一般！

……咳咳，不好意思跑题了。

Epson涂装的NSX真车加了2004年到2009年期间的
全日本GT赛事。

当时正是全日本GT锦标赛向国际Super GT系列赛转型的阶段。

这款EPSON NSX参加的是2008年系列赛的后半段赛程，并在第8
轮中跑出
第二名的好成绩。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
In 1955, Mercedes-Benz pulled out
of all motorsports events.

It wasn’t until 1988 that it officially
made its return.

And it did so with this car, the Sauber-Mercedes.

Because it was painted all silver, the car was called
the "Silver Arrow."

Actually, there’s a story behind the name.
Would you care to hear it?
2
zh:
在1955年，Mercedes-Benz选择从汽车运动赛事中抽身。

直到1988年，他们才正式推出这辆Sauber-Mercedes，

并用它上演了一出王者归来！

因为采用了通体银色的车身，它得到了“银箭”的称号。

其实这个名字背后还有一段故事。你想要听吗？

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
It all goes back some 90 years,
to the Eifel race of 1934.

Back then, the all-white Mercedes F1 was deemed
<1kg> too heavy for competition.

To reduce its weight, a mechanic scraped off the car's
paint, exposing its aluminum body.

It was this silver-colored car
that ended up winning the race.

This car was dubbed the "Silver Arrow," instantly becoming
a symbol for racing excellence.

Sinc then, silver has been Germany’s national
racing color.

Of course, sponsorship liveries are much
more common today.

And race cars painted in their national colors
are very much a thing of the past.

But if youpre interested in racing history, you should
look into the national race cors of other cotries
zh:
这个故事要说回到90多年前，那是1934年的埃菲尔比赛……

当时的那辆全白色梅赛德斯F1赛车因为超重<1kg>，无法参加比赛。

为了减重，一名机械师直接刮掉了喷漆，露出了铝制的
赛车车身。

最终，这辆原色梅赛德斯赛车还赢下了比赛！

于是赛车运动历史上最传奇的名称之一“银箭”便诞生了！

4那之后，银色就成为了德国的赛车运动主色调！

当然，今天的赛车运动中赞助商涂装已经非常普及。

采用国家官方配色的赛车已经成为了历史。

不过，如果你对F1历史感兴趣，
不妨多了解一下其他国家的官方配色！

en:
When it comes to genuine kei sportscars…

This Suzuki Cappuccino is truly a legend.

It has a front-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout,
making it an ‘FR’ car.

Lift up its bonnet and you’ll find that its engine
is mounted near the centre of the car.

That alone should convince you that
it’s a real sportscar!

Released in 1991, the Cappuccino...

Is often grouped with its competitors,
the Mazda AZ-1 and Honda Beat.

Combing their initials, the three may be referred to
as the ‘A-B-C’ of kei sportscars.
zh:
如果要讨论最正宗的轻型跑车……

这款Suzuki Cappuccino就是真正的传奇。

它采用前置引擎、后轮驱动布局，也就是所谓的“前置
后驱”车。

抬起它的引擎盖，你会发现它的引擎位置更贴近车身的
正中。

这就是它作为真正跑车的明证！

这款Cappuccino在1991年上市……

常被拿来和它的竞争者Mazda AZ-1和Honda Beat相提并论。

如果把这三款车的型号名称首字母连在一起，就形成了
轻型跑车的“A-B-C”，代表了最基础的车型。

en:
This is an Abarth car—you can tell straightaway
from the ‘scorpion’ emblem.

Abarth is one of the most storied brands
in motorsport history.

It was established by Carlo Abarth...

Who began his career as a racer and engineer of
two- and four-wheel vehicles in the 1920s...

And later had success as a tuner for FIAT.

Today, an Abarth 595 that is based on the old FIAT 500
will fetch a pretty penny!

By the way, about that scorpion emblem...

It comes from the fact that Carlo Abarth was born
in November, making him a Scorpio!
P
zh:
从这个“蝎子”的标志你就能一眼看出，这是一辆Abarth的车。

Abarth是汽车历史上最富传奇色彩的品牌之一。

这个品牌由卡洛·阿巴斯创立。

他在上世纪20年代以赛车手和两轮及四轮车辆工程师的
身份开始了自己的职业生涯……

随后，他因为对FIAT车辆的优异调校而闻名于世。

时至今日，一辆基于老款FIAT 500改装的Abarth 595
依然能卖出高价！

哦，顺带一说，它之所以用蝎子作为车标……

是因为卡洛·阿巴斯出生于十一月，所以是天蝎座！

en:
The main role of the Z33, introduced in 2001, was to resurrect
the Z, and serve as a symbol of the revival of Nissan itself.

Therefore, it was a car that had to succeed.

Because the Z has been a defining symbol for Nissan through the
years, it naturally embraced the design heritage of the company.

That said, we couldn't give it a retro look.

We needed to retain the essence and spirit
of notabe Nissans of the past...

...while giving it a thoroughly modern character.

The inspiration for the car's design language was
the S30 and the CSP first-generation Silvia.

And, it may be difficult to notice, but there are hnts
of the SP Fairlady in the body section.

All of thisʇade te Z33 more modern
and possess different proportions than the S30...

...bu I fee i's sill intanly

Z33于2001年首次亮相，
它的使命是复活Z系列，并成为日产复兴的象征。

因此，这是一款不许失败的汽车。

作为日产的代表车型，Z33必须体现出公司的设计传统……

但又不能太“复古”。

因此，我们必须保留过去成就的精髓和精神……

再以完善的现代特征进行展现。

它的设计v言可以追溯到S30和第一代Silvia CSP。

而且，容易被人忽略的一个点是
——其车身部分还有些Fairlady SP的影子。

这些设计元素都使得Z33在比例和主题方面较S30更加现代i

但你还是一眼就能看出，这是一辆Z系车。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
Design-wise, the Z34 sports a more classic look
than the Z33.

First of all, its wheelbase has been shortened
by <100mm>...

Giving it long-nose proportions.

And the shape of its roof, with the window decal
at the very front...

Is consciously taken from the S30.

In contrast, the massive rear fender, which squeezes
the shape of the body from front to rear...

Lends to it an aggressiveness never before
seen in a Z-car.

Of course, it wasn’t easy evolving the Z33's styling.

But in short, if the Z33 evoked modern elegance...

The Z34 was more of an authentic FR sports car
with added aggressiveness.
zh:
从设计上看，Z34比Z33的外观更回归经典。

首先，轴距缩短了<100mm>……

显得车头相对更长。

其车顶的形状以及最前面的车窗贴花……

则特意延续了S30的设计风格。

相比之下，巨大的后挡泥板让车身的重心从前向后挪……

虽然确实时不时会出一些小毛病。

当然，我们的变速箱没有那些小毛病。

 I was torn because we were going to replace the

Some styling elements are particularly iconic,

这款被命名为“Daytona”的跃马是

紧凑收束的后置驾驶舱。

就连有机玻璃大灯也采用了流线型的优雅设计。

%

speaker: Sarah

en:
Yes! It's a design where the rear of the body appears to
abruptly cut off.

Much like streamline designs, they're known to have
excellent aerodynamics.

Dr. Wunibald Kamm, the person who came up with this, was a
professor at the University of Stuttgart in the 1930s.

Therein lies the reason why this particular design is called
the "Kamm Tail."

We also refer to it as "Coda Tronca" in Italian.
?
zh:
没错！采用这种设计的汽车后部就像
被整齐地切掉一块。

卡姆式与流线型车身设计很接近，而且都以
优秀的空气动力学效应闻名。

这一设计是由斯图加特大学的Wunibald Kamm博士
于上世纪30年代提出的，

随即以设计者的名字冠名。

在意大利语中，我们也把它叫作“Coda Tronca”。

en:
Not only is the 308 the forebear of all modern 8-cylinder
Ferraris, it is undoubtedly the most popular of them all.

It may also be the longest-lasting.

If one includes the 328 variant, its production run
spanned from 1975 to 1989.

The car's success is due to its pure and timeless design.

It is also said to be very well balanced...

And serves as a perfect example of Pininfarina’s
design philosophy.

It even revives classic themes from the Dino 246,
such as the flared wheel arches...

The iconic side air intake, the dynamic rear pillars...

And the truncated tail with four round taillights.

Indeed, all of these elemnt wre transformed to express
a very odern form for its day.<next id=22509 typ=9
zh:
308不仅是所有现代8缸法拉利跑车的鼻祖，
而且无疑是所有车款当中最受欢迎的一款。

它可能也是持续量产最久的一款法拉利。

如果将328版本也算进去，
其生产时间足足从1975年延续到1989年。

这都要归功于它纯粹且经得起时代考验的设计。

在评论家口中，它的平衡性同样首屈一指……

还完美诠释了宾尼法利纳的设计理念。

speaker: Ed Welburn

en:
I’m a big fan of all things Chaparral.

The Chaparral 2J was the most innovative Chaparral.

It's undoubtedly the most radical racecar
of the legendary CanAm series.

Its wedge-shaped nose, squared off body
and twin fans on the rear...

...instantly made you want to know
what mysteries lay below its skin.

Its design looks more like a scientific test bed
than an agile racecar.

But the Chaparral 2J could
outperform everything.

That's why it was eventually banned from racing
because of its incredible technical advantage.

I would have created a body shape which was more in
keeping with he front-end design...

...or at least painted the center section white
zh:
我是Chaparral所有车型的忠实拥簇。

Chaparral 2J是他们最具创新性的一款车型。

毋庸置疑，它是传奇的美加系列当中最激进的一款赛车。

看着它的楔形车头、方正的车身和车位的两部风扇……

让你不由得对它的性能产生好奇。

从设计上看，它更像是一件“实验品”
而不是一台“赛车”，

#Chaparral 2J的确凭实力做到了藐视所有竞争对手。

这就是为什么它最终被禁止参加比赛的原因——
它的技术优势领先到无以复加。

就个人而言，我更倾向于打造
前后设计更加一致的车身。

zh:
埃德先生，能见到您是我们的荣幸！

埃德先生是通用汽车全球设计中心的副总裁，他为世界

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
The C3 Corvette Stingray was a major departure
from the C2 Corvette.

It was meant to be something like an accessible
concept car.

The fender shapes are bold, the waist is tight...

And everything, from the pop-up headlights
to the stylish side exhaust...

Are very much like a ‘show car’.

Even the door handles were innovative!

Not only was the interior was inspired
by NASA rocket ships...

But there was a time when all of the astronauts
drove C3 Corvette Stingrays.
zh:
C3 Corvette Stingray的设计是对C2 Corvette的一场告别。

它设计之初的目标是要成为可以上路的概念车。

前后挡泥板的形状大胆、狂野，中部线条收紧……

从上翻大灯到时尚有型的侧出排气管……

它从头至脚都非常像一辆“展台车”。

甚至连门把手造型都充满创新！

据说，车身内饰的灵感来自于NASA的火箭与飞船……

不仅如此，有一段时间，所有宇航员的座驾
都是C3 Corvette Stingrays。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The original 2001 996-based GT3 is one of
the best-kept Porsche secrets!

Both technically and mechanically, it is the most raw
of all the GT3s!

It featured a naturally aspirated GT1/Mezger flat-6 in a
reinforced chassis geared towards motorsports.

The success of the GT3 was unexpected, with demand
exceeding the limited production run!

It is pure magic!
;
zh:
2001款996 GT3是Porsche最大的秘密武器之一！

无论是技术方面，还是机械方面，
这款车型的凶悍程度都冠绝Porsche所推出的所有GT3！

它搭载了来自GT1/Mezger的自然进气水平对置六缸引擎
以及赛车级的强化悬挂。

GT3的成功来得如此突然，订单纷至沓来，
远超原有的限量发售数！

这辆车简直像有魔力一般！

speaker: Sarah
role_zh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
en: Have you ever heard of Porsche's Mezger engine？
zh: 您听说过Porsche的Mezger引擎吗？

speaker: Sarah
role_zh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
en:
That's correct! It's an engine created by Porsche's
legendary engineer Hans Mezger!

He's responsible for the 911's traditional air-cooled
engines, as well as race engines for F1 and Le Mans.

Although 911 engines became water-cooled starting with
the 996...

...the engines for the GT2, GT3 and Turbo
were still rooted in designs by Mezger.
zh:
没错！这款引擎由Porsche的传奇工程师汉斯·梅茨格打造！

他负责设计了911的风冷引擎，以及
F1和勒芒赛事用的赛车引擎。

尽管自996之后，911的引擎都换成了水冷……

但梅茨格的设计理念依然根植于GT2，GT3以及911 Turbo之中。

en:
It is really a clever design in that it is larger
than the original but scaled up perfectly!

 If you put an original next to it, you won't
believe the difference in size.

The original car was really quite small.

The shut-lines play a key part and play an important role
in modernizing the GT40.

The larger size allows larger and taller people to fit
comfortably and allows them get in and out easily.

This is truly an iconic "daily driver" super car
with Ford reliability and parts access.

The styling inside and out has proven to be timeless.
A true collector's car for the serious enthusiast.

and the exterior styling exudes extreme passion and excitement.

the end effect is one that's relatively prominent.<next id=2001706 type

在1980年代，汽车设计的历史上掀起了一股非常独特的浪潮。

This car was introduced as a baby Aston to make it affordable
and attract a broader audience.

The design of this car was unmistakably “Aston Martin."
In fact, it looked much more trim and agile than other Astons.

In my opinion, I prefer the Vantage V8...

...more than its much heavier
and larger siblings.

 Later, the company put a V-12 into this tight package.

With that, this Aston made my list of ideal cars.
zh:
为了宣传这款车的亲民价格，吸引更多的受众，
官方给它起了一个绰号，“阿斯顿宝宝”。

它的设计充分地彰显了“Aston Martin”的特色。
与其他车型对比，它看上去更苗条，也更敏捷。

相比于那些体积更大、重量更重的姊妹车型……

……我个人更偏爱这款Vantage V8。

后来，设计师们还将一部V12引擎
塞进了它紧凑的引擎盖下。

有了这项升级，这款Aston Martin也
顺理成章变成了我的理想车型之一。

This is the seventh-generation Golf GTI.

The first GTI established the high-performance
three-box hatchback theme...

That is still very popular around the world.

Since then, the GTI has undergone several evolutions.

While there were a few duds over the years,
this GTI was definitely a ‘hit’.

The size of the car has been gradually
growing with each evolution.

This seventh-generation model got everything right,
from the way it sits to the way it moves.

Not only were these elements balanced, but together
they contributed to creating something better.
zh:
这是一辆七代Golf GTI。

它采用三厢掀背设计，并搭载动力强劲的性能套件。
这也是从初代起就确定的设计思路。

每一代Golf GTI的推出，都会经历一些演化和改变。

多年以来，有些改变成功了，而另一些则不尽如人意。
这一台，是成功的幸运儿之一。

历代的车身尺寸在演化中逐步扩大，

这一代的Golf GTI就做到了将所有的要素搭配地恰到好处。

它们的结合形成了运动的姿态，强大的气势和灵活性，
同时还散发出一种和谐感与力量感。

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
This is where Jeep culture started.

A purely functional design to meet military needs.

Now, the form-follows-function approach doesn’t
always guarantee success.

Only on rare occasions does it work—and in this case
the vehicle became an icon.

The engineers who worked on this program...

Must have had a good sense of proportion
and high design standards.

They knew precisely where to work their magic.

In some cases, the depth of the flanges helped to strengthen
the panels so that thinner pieces could be used.

Truly impressive work!
zh:
这辆原版车款就是整个Jeep文化的起点。

作为服役车辆，它的设计完全强调功能性。

这种外形为功能服务的设计出发点
显然无法保证美学上的成功。

或者我应该说，成功的几率绝无仅有。
而这样的成功就落在了Jeep身上，缔造出了汽车史上的经典符号。

参与这项开发计划的工程师们……

……很好地掌握了比例的x念，
并且对设计品质有极高的标准。

他们将外观的弧度与半径计算得分毫不差。

例如，他们会通过采用凹陷度更深的轮缘来强化板件的刚度，
以减板材厚度，达到减重的效果。

光凭这一点，就值Us我们向那q期计者们脱帽致敬。

en:
Both Ferrari and Pininfarina have a certain philosophy.

And that philosophy is that a Ferrari "must
be beautiful and distinctive."

The La Ferrari was introduced as the pinnacle of
technology, aerodynamics and styling.

Like its predecessors, it stood as an expression of
pure functional beauty.

There are no gimmicky surfaces or details in its design.

It stood apart from the more aggressive-looking supercars of its time.
zh:
Ferrari和Pininfarina都秉承了同一设计理念：

每一辆Ferrari都必须“美观而独特”。

这台LaFerrari就代表了技术、空气动力学和美学风格上的极致。

和其前辈们一样，它同样遵循“性能高于造型”的设计思路，

摒弃一切花哨的装饰曲面或细节，

在众多外观更加“唬人”的超级跑车中显得鹤立鸡群。

An iconic cream white body with Shelby’s signature
blue stripes...

Were once the signs of a genuine GT Mustang.

The original Mustang combined great proportions
with a simple and clean design.

Despite the special nature of this G.T. 350...

No parts were added to its exterior
due to regulations.

However, it did come with a lowered suspension,
wide tyres and that iconic stripe.

If I could own a Mustang, this would be
at the top of my list.

zh:
当你看到经典的奶白色车身和Shelby蓝色条纹，
就代表这是一辆血统纯正的GT Mustang……

……当然了，G.T.350肯定要比人气超高的
基础车型更胜一筹。

原款Mustang的车身比例本就十分优秀，

设计方面也以简洁、精炼为主。

受赛事规定限制，这台Shelby G.T.350没有增加任何外部部件，

只是调低了悬挂系统，安装了宽胎
以及加入了标志性的涂装。

要是我想买一台Mustang，那么这款车绝对是我的首选。

role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
This is the legendary 1963 Corvette Sting Ray
‘Split Window’ coupe.

Regarding its name, the ‘Split Window’...

This comes from the very sleek rod in the rear window.

This rod is not only a distinguishing feature...

It also allows the profile of the car to remain
uninterrupted in its flow.

This car is so well-balanced from top to bottom,
and from end to end.

I particularly love the fender shape!

Clearly, it was inspired by the Italian streamliners
of the 1950s.

When I look at the sleek undulating lines of
the 1963 Sting Ray...

It really does remind me of its underwater
namesake!
zh:
这是传说中的1963款科尔维特Sting Ray
“Split Window”双门跑车。

“Split Window”这个绰号的由来是指它的后车窗被一根立柱一分为二。

这根独树一帜的立柱……

……让车辆的整体轮廓更加连贯和流畅。

我还特别喜爱它的挡泥板的形状，
其灵感应该来源于1950年代意大利汽车的流线型车身。

这辆车z头到尾、从上到下都充满平衡感，

堪称永恒的经典设计。

每次看到那起伏流畅的车身外形……

……我就不由想起那条生活在水底的流线型生物。

没错，那就这辆车名字的来源，魔鬼鱼。

The surfaces are well-sculpted into tasteful shapes.
And the body is muscular, with great proportions.

Though the wheels are the largest of their kind,
the car seems to almost hug the ground.

Indeed, the Mercedes A45 AMG has been carefully designed
To express a tough and cool attitude.

I want one in my garage!

这辆Mercedes A45 AMG的设计十分成熟，
性能强悍而且外形帅气。

其车身轮廓充满肌肉感，而且保持了合理的比例。

车身表面经过精心塑形，弧形线条丰富而流畅。

设计师甚至考虑到了轮胎的问题，
最宽尺寸的车胎可以让这辆Mercedes牢牢扒住地面。

这辆车的优势在于不忘初心，
绝无任何花哨的设计，只用实力说话。

这样的车，连我也想买一辆！

Its design was a radical departure from that of
previous Corvettes.

Many of its shapes, like those characterized by
its beautiful fenders, were inspired by Italian streamliners.

The strong crease that defines the car contributes to
its evocation of speed.

每个表面都经过精心设计，呈现不同程度的拱起。

en:
This is the original Mini. I can't think of any
other car design that is so efficient.

It's the ultimate expression of a 4-seat passenger vehicle.
It truly has a 'timeless design'.

The original Mini was, for its time, an unusual
front-wheel-drive compact.

It was developed for minimal power and
maximum interior space.

This packaging was revolutionary for the 20th century.

The car was created in 1955 by the BMC development
team, led by Sir Alec Issigonis.

After that, John Cooper tuned the car with
twin carburettors and disc brakes.

Thus the Mini Cooper S you see here was born.<next id=1900106 type=9׾
zh:
这是一辆初代MINI。
我觉得没有比它更高效的汽车设计了。

它就是4座乘用车的终极体现。
这真是一款“不过时的设计”。

这款初代MINI在当时是一辆非常罕见的前驱紧凑型车。

它的开发思路就是追求最小的动力和
最大的可用内部空间。

这样的产品规划在20世纪是非常具有革新性的。

在1955年，由亚{克·伊斯戈尼斯爵士领导的英国汽车集团开发团队
打造了这台MINI。

之后，约翰·库珀对车型进行了调校，
加入了双化油器和碟式制动器……

于是，你眼前的这Q辆MINI Cooper S就诞生了。

Although it's not exactly a "hashiriya," or street racer,

It's a car you should drive at least once in Gran Turismo.

en:
The number of cars participating in the 1991 Le Mans race
was only 38, but among those was the new Peugeot 905.

There were also perennial powerhouses like Mercedes-Benz,
Jaguar and Porsche sharing that starting grid.

To take them all on, Mazda entered two 787B race cars.

Of those two, the No. 55 car, which started the race in 19th
position, gradually worked its way up the running order...

Until it found its way to the front and finished on top!
A dramatic first victory for Japanese manufacturers.

To this day, I haven't forgotten the famous green
and red livery of that race machine.<next id=1900306 type=
zh:
在1991年参加勒芒耐力赛的赛车仅有寥寥38辆，

如Mercedes-Benz、Jaguar和Porsche等等。

Mazda派出了两辆787B赛车来挑战这些强大的对手。

在这两辆车中，从第19位发车的55号赛车
步步为营，不断提升自己的排位……

……最后终于攀升到领跑位置，并以头名完赛！
这是日本车厂的第一次获胜，过程充满了戏剧性。

The prototype and final production model
of the original NSX...

...was designed by my friend and former chief
designer at Honda, Masato Nakano.

The performance target for the NSX was
to surpass the Ferrari 328 and 348...

...so you know it had plenty of fighting power.

The GT500 class adopted a stepped-bottom rule in 2007, and that
year, this car took the title, winning five of nine races

Because of its incredible speed, you can almost say
that the series imposed a weight-handicap system.

The next year, in 2008, the NSX's main highlight was a 2nd-place
finish in the eighth race of the season at Autoplis.

都是由我的朋友、前Honda首席设计师中野正人所设计的。

所以可想而知，它的战斗力极其惊人。

GT500组别的赛事在2007年采用了阶梯式淘汰规则，

在这一年里，这辆NSX不仅赢得了冠军，还拿下了
九场比赛中的五场胜利。

因为它所向无敌的速度，甚至会让人们怀疑这项系列赛
是否对其他参赛车辆采用了加重平衡制度。

在接下来的2008年，NSX最亮眼的表现则出现在奥托波里斯赛道，

Imagine transforming a little French city car

widened flanks and central dual exhausts.

for the front and rear grilles.

后轮的“管装”风道线条……

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The R32 Skyline GT-R is popular the world over, but this NISMO
version is really something else.

NISMO, or "Nissan Motorsport International," is the company's
motorsports division.

It was established in 1984.

Back then, Japan was totally into international touring car races
starring the Super Silhouette and other Nissan greats.

Actually, ever since the 1960s, Nissan’s works team has won
many of Japan’s top grand prix races.

This wealth of experience is what made NISMO possible.

And, with all the work that NISMO put into this GT-R,
you know it was destined to be a legend!
zh:
R32 Skyline GT-R在全世界都非常有人气，但这台NISMO
却有其独特之处。

NISMO即“Nissan国际赛车”的简写，负责管理Nissan的赛车部门。

它成立于1984年。

当时，以“超级剪影”和其他Nissan大赛为代表的
国际房车赛令整个日本都为之痴狂。

事实上，自1960年代以来，Nissan官方车队就登顶了
许多场日本顶级的大奖赛。

这些在比赛中积累的宝贵经验成为了NISMO设计的基石。

只要了解NISMO在这台GT-R中倾注的努力，你就知道
它是一台不折不扣的传奇！

en:
Most every rally-racing enthusiast knows about the "Evo."
The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution is really that historic.

This is the Evo III, the third-generation model.
It's a car with a storied history.

It helped Mitsubishi ace driver Tommi Mäkinen win
his first WRC drivers title in 1996.

Mäkinen then went on to win four consecutive
drivers titles piloting different iterations of the "Evo."

He was truly a legendary rally driver.

And, the car that put him on his path to history was a rally
car based on this Mitsubishi Lancer Evo III.

This is a second-generation Subaru Impreza STi.

In Japan, the Impreza STi and the Mitsubishi Lancer Evo
were known to have an intense rivalry.

The second-generation STi featured numerous upgrades, none more
evident than in this 2004 model.

Notice how the rear wheel arch appears to be slightly
widened?

This was done to give the car wide tires and wheels.
The suspension and engine were also improved.

This car certainly turned heads after its time trial run
at the Nürburgring in Germany.

It was the first Impreza to complete a lap
in less than eight minutes!

这是通过加宽轮毂和使用宽胎来实现的，悬挂和引擎

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
Thanks to the technical know-how of aerodynamics specialist
Malcolm Sayer, this Jaguar D-Type...

...was a dramatic departure for Jaguar in that it embraced
a new dynamic form.

From the XK120 to the XK150, Jaguar had pursued a sort of
French elegance, but the D-Type was a pure revolution.

With a little more than 70 units built, the D-Type began
competing at Le Mans in 1954.

While it came up short in its first year, it won overall
victories in 1955 and 1956, a historic feat for Jaguar.

A truly iconic car, its dynamic design would be carried over
to the XJ13 and, later, the famous E-Type.
~
zh:
得益于空气动力学专家马尔科姆·塞尔所提供的
技术专业知识，这辆捷豹D-Type……

与过去的捷豹截然不同，采用了全新的动力学外观。

从XK120到XK150，捷豹一直追求某种法式的优雅，
而D-Type的推出带来了一场全方位的革新。

在生产了70余辆后，D-Type于1954年开始参加勒芒比赛。

虽然第一年出师不利，但655年和56年却大获全胜，
在捷豹的历史上写下了厚重的一笔。

这是一辆真正标志性的赛车，它的动力学设置
后来在XJ13上得到沿用，并被此后著名的E-type所继承。

Following a trend set by the 4CV, the Renault R8 was the
third generation of the marque’s rear-engine saloons.

Yet the addition of four-wheel disc brakes made it
uniquely modern.

The R8 Gordini is an upgraded version, quickened by
the magic touch of the great Amédée Gordini.

Affectionately called the ‘Lunchbox,’ it has blunt lines
and an overall spartan design.

1966 saw the addition of twin headlights.

Dressed in French racing blue, with two white stripes,
the Gordini truly has a charm that’s all its own.
zh:
Renault R8继承4CV的传统，成为该知名品牌的
第三代后置引擎轿车。

四轮碟刹的加入为该系列增添了一抹独特的现代气息。

R8 Gordini是系列中的一款升级版车型，在伟大的设计师
阿梅德·戈迪尼的神奇手笔下，该车的速度进一步提升。

此车因其简洁的线条和整体简约设计
而被亲切地称为“饭盒”。

1966年，该车增加了双前大灯版本。

Gordini车身喷涂法国赛车蓝，配以两条白色条纹，
有一种浑然天成的魅力。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
I never knew that the Abarth 1500 Biposto Bertone was also
called the B.A.T. 1.

But when I consider its round body section
and dual front air intakes...

...its design links to B.A.Ts 5, 7 and 9 become
all the more obvious.

The gentle tail fins and thin dorsal fin that run down
the center of the car are another case in point.

Franco Scaglione, the man who designed this car,
joined Bertone as its hief stylist in 1952.

This car was the product of his wonderfully eccentric
design mind.

As the first B.A.T. (Berlinetta Aerodinamica Tecnica), it has
an important place in the history of automotive design.
zh:
我之前不知道Abarth 1500 Biposto Bertone
也被称为“B.A.T.1”，

直到看到它圆润的车体和双层前进气口……

它与B.A.T. 5、7和9在设计上的一脉相承
就显露无疑。

柔和的尾翼和纵贯车身的中央长背翼
也体现了这一点。

设计师弗朗哥·斯凯荣内在1952年加入Bertone公司
担任首席设计师。

这款车就是他奇思妙想的产物。

作为第一辆B.A.T.（Berlinetta Aerodinamica Tecnica），
它在汽车设计史上占有相当重要的地位。

The Ferrari Enzo, named after Ferrari’s founder, marked
a radical stylistic change in Ferrari’s history.

It was certainly one of the most iconic sports cars of the 2000s.

Directly inspired by the aerodynamic shapes
of contemporary Formula 1 machines...

...it made a lasting impression with its pointed nose.

Like a jetfighter, driven by functionality and performance,
its intersecting blockscreated space for its air intakes.

The cabin was also clearly inspired by aeronautical shapes.

At the rear, there appeared, for the first time,
dual circular taillights...

...which would later be found on the F43
and other subsequent Ferraris.
*

以法拉利的创始人命名的法拉利Enzo标志着
法拉利史上的一次激进的设计变革。

它无疑是2000年代最具标志性的跑车之一。

此车的设计直接受到了当代F1赛车的

以其尖锐的车鼻给人留下了“凶猛”的印象。

它就像一架喷气式战斗机，注重功能和性能，
互相交错的矩形表面为进气口创造了空间。

车厢设计也明显受到航空器的启发。

在车尾，两侧的双圆形尾灯首次亮相……

en:
A legend among supercars of the 1980s,
the Ferrari GTO...

...combined the most advanced performance, technology
and style of its era.

Despite the nominal nod to the iconic 250 GTO from 1962...

...this car actually incorporated the design of the popular 308 GTB,
though slightly stretched to match its longer wheelbase.

Its main character came from the big front-spoiler
and four rectanguar daylights...

...as well as the wide fenders covering its big wheels.

The gearbox hanging below the bumper
was framed by four round exhausts.

It was always a wonderful sight to see.

The only details recallig the vintage GTO...

...were the famous three slanted side vents behinthe rear wheel
and he enlarged "duck-tail" spoiler.
zh:
法拉利GTO是80年代超级跑车中的传奇之作……

它集合了当时最先进的性能、技术和当代设计品味。

尽管名字向1962年经典的250 GTO致敬……

但实际上它采用了当时最受欢迎的308 GTB的设计，
不过稍微拉长了车身，以适应更长的轴距。

它的主要特征包括大面积的前导流板和四颗矩形日间行车灯……

以及盖住硕大轮毂的宽大轮拱。

挂在保险杠下方的变速箱被左右四根圆形排气管夹在中间。

每每看到，都让人觉得惊艳。

唯一能让人回想起那款经典GTO的细节i…

是后轮后方的三道标志性斜向通风口，和车尾部
R大号的“RG尾t扰流板。

en:
The R.S. 01 was a true mid-engine competition car
belonging to the GT category.

extremely aggressive.

The huge carbon rear wing always impressed, along with
the front spoiler and the rear diffuser.

in the front and rear...

...so it adopted the style of the lights and grille
of the production Mégane.

The F430 is strongly derived from the 360 Modena,

While taking the body panels and glass parts from the 360,

Are inspired by the ‘shark nose’ front
of the 1961 Ferrari 156 F1.

And the four Enzo-inspired circular tail lights
add to its aggressive look.

四个Enzo风格的环形尾灯则进一步地强化了它的进攻性。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The DS brand was created by the PSA Group to renew
the unconventional spirit of the legendary Citroën DS19.

And this DS3 was the first car of the brand.

However, there is no similarity or stylistic reference
to the original DS from 1955.

Aiming instead at a French "chic" imaginary, its shapes
are a little complex, with showy decorations.

On the whole, I find the extremely compact and energetic
proportions to be very pleasant.

And the "shark fin" of the central pillar represents,
I think, its most characteristic design element.
zh:
“DS”是由PSA集团创建的新品牌，旨在为传奇的Citroën DS19
打破常规的精神注入新鲜的血液。

这辆DS3是该品牌的第一款车。

然而，该车与1955年的原版DS在风格和设计上毫无传承。

专注于营造一种法式的“别致”印象，因而选择了稍显复杂，
而且外向的华丽装饰。

整体上，我觉得它的车身比例给人以一种
非常紧凑而活力动感的印象，看起来赏心悦目。

我个人认为中柱处的“鲨鱼鳍”是此车最具特色的设计元素。

The sixth-generation of the Toyota Celica has the most
character of all the models in its long lineage.

What we have here is the rally version.

Aesthetically, it’s nearly identical to the production car,
apart from the raised rear wing and a few aero features.

An example of modern Japanese "bio-design," it is notably
distinguished by its four rounded headlights.

Meanwhile, in other places...

...the Celica draws inspiration from other Toyota sports coupes
of its day, such as the Supra and the Soarer.
R
zh:
第六代Toyota Celica在其悠久的族系历史上拥有
最独特的个性。

我们眼前的是一辆拉力赛版本车型。

从外观上看，除了抬高的尾翼和安装了几项
空气动力学套件，它和量产版车型几乎别无二致。

这款车是现代日本“仿生设计”的完美示例，
其四盏圆形大灯尤其彰显了这一特色。

与此同时，你可以在多处设计上看到……

Celica从当时的其他Toyota运动型双门跑车，
例如Supra和Soarer身上汲取了不少灵感。

to manage air flow and cooling in a unique way.

The windshield and side glass are like slits, giving the
GT by Citroën a very private, sinister look.

was also designed with racing in mind.

When it came to the racing variant, I tried to retain as much

My aim of preserving the beauty and silhouette of the car
extended to the livery.

I also wanted to ensure that it looked good on the track.

I achieved this by giving it a wide rear axle, the kind
expected of a Super Taikyu car.

As a result, it looks very striking when overtaking.

So if you ever meet me on the track, be sure to let me

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
This here’s a legend of American stock car racing.

In stock car racing, production-model cars are raced
pretty much as-is.

The Superbird’s large rear wing and long front nose
were essential tools...

...for winning NASCAR races, the top tier of stock
car racing in the United States.

Basically, they were special racing parts
for a production car.

In its effort to meet NASCAR hoologation,
the Superbird was sold for but one year...

...and few were ever produced.

Afterwards, stock car races began to feature more
and more pure race cars.

Indeed, this car is from an age when street cars
an race cars greatly resembled each other.
zh: 这一辆是美国改装赛车比赛中的传奇。 在改装赛车比赛中，量产型的车辆通常是以原始的出厂配置的状态直接参与竞速。 这辆Superbird的大号后翼和长车鼻都是竞速利器…… 能够帮助它赢得美国的顶级改装赛车赛事——纳斯卡赛车。 事实上，这些车身部件都是专门服务于量产型车辆的特殊竞速部件。 为了满足纳斯卡赛车的赛事资格认证条件， Superbird仅对外销售一年…… 总产量也不多。 在那之后，改装赛车比赛开始涌入越来越多种类的赛车。 的确，V款车来自于那个公路车和赛车 相似度极高的时代。

Do you know the history of AMG?

It started out as a company that built racing engines.

At the helm were two engineers.

They were Hans Werner Aufrecht and Erhard Melcher.

These two worked in the race-engine forge
of Daimler-Benz.

When Benz took a hiatus from motorsport...

...Aufrecht and Melcher decided to go into
business together.

They founded their engineering company out of
Aufrecht’s house in Großaspach, Germany.

Taking the initials of Aufrecht, Melcher, and Großaspach,
they christened their company "AMG."

That was in back in 1967!
zh:
你了解AMG的历史吗？

它起初只是一家专门打造赛车引擎的公司……

由两名工程师汉斯·维尔纳·奥夫莱西特……

和埃尔哈特·梅尔赫执掌。

当奔驰暂时远离赛车运动后……

奥夫莱西特和梅尔赫决定共同创业。

于是他们在奥夫莱西特位于德国格罗萨斯帕赫
的家里创办了他们的工程公司。

他们从奥弗莱希特、梅尔赫和
格罗萨斯帕赫三个名字中

各取一个首字母，为公司起名为“AMG”。

那是在1967年！

The NSX is a Japanese GT race car.
It waged battle in the All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC).

The NSX made its first appearance in the JGTC’s GT500 class
during the 1996 season.

Despite putting up a good fight...

...it was unable to overcome the era's powerhouses,
such as the Nissan Skyline GT-R and Toyota Supra.

However, in 2000, the NSX took a great evolutionary
leap forward.

 team of five NSXs won four of seven races that year.

Ryo Michigami in the No.16 Castrol MUGEN NSX took home the driver’s title.

This was the first time an NSX won the JGTC championshp.
zh:
这辆NSX是参加全日本GT锦标赛的赛车啊！它的实力已经在2000年
全日本GT锦标赛中得到了充分证明。

NSX在1996赛季全日本GT锦标赛的GT500组别中首次亮相。

尽管拼尽全力……

仍然无法撼动如日产Skyline GT-R和丰田Supra
这样的强大对手。

不过当时间来到2000年，NSX得到了飞跃般的进化。

在这个赛季，总共五 NSX组成的参赛阵容拿下了
七场比赛中的四场胜利……

而驾驶16号嘉实多无限NSX赛车的道上龙
更是赢下了车手冠军头衔。

这也是NSX在全日EGT锦标赛的历史上首次夺魁。

en:
More than anything, I associate the Volvo 240 series
with racing.

The 2-door sedan turbo model made a big splash at European
and German touring car championships.

So much so that its hallmark boxy shape earned it
the nickname ‘the Flying Brick.’

Racing performance aside, this Estate model
is a legend among legends.

Between 1974 and 1993, the Volvo 240 series sold
some 2.7 million units...

Of which, 950,000 were the Estate model. Now, more than
thirty years after its retirement...

It remains the classic estate car that people
all over the world still love to this day!
zh:
在我心目中，Volvo 240系列都堪称非常优秀的赛车。

其中的2门轿车涡轮增压版本曾在欧洲和德国的房车
赛事中引起了巨大轰动。

由于影响力巨大，乃至于其方块状外形
为它赢得了“飞砖”的昵称。

除了比赛表现之外，这款Estate车型在市场上也堪称
传奇中的传奇。

在1974到1993之间，Volvo 240系列总共售出了
大约270万台……

其中95万台都是Estate型号。即便在停产超过三十年的
现在……

它依然是全世界车迷所深爱的一款经典旅行车！

You might say that Porsche is Volkswagen-inspired not only
in the architecture of its cars but also their overall design…

Which is said to be owing to the genius of Erwin Komenda,
Ferry Porsche’s right-hand engineer.

Yet it was Ferry’s son Butzi who would work this theme
into the modern 911.

With headlamps set at the end of its elongated front wings...

A sloping rear, and elliptical side windows...

It is a basic example of the ‘Jaray-style.’
Q
zh:
很多人认为Porsche不仅在其汽车的架构上
受到Volkswagen的启发，整体设计理念方面也是如此……

这位工程师同时也是费利·保时捷的得力助手。

其实是费利的儿子（绰号“布奇”）。

在前翼子板顶端设置的头灯……

后溜背的车尾和椭圆形侧窗……

这些都是典型的“贾雷式气动设计”风格的体现。

in the 1960s.

and "Reutter" went off to make seats under Recaro!

.

Nismo is the name of Nissan’s in-house works team.

They are famous for building production cars packed
with racing know-how.

In 2004, to mark its 20th anniversary, Nismo introduced
this R34 GT-R Z-tune.

Of all the Nismo products, this one takes the crown.

At the time of its release, the R34 Skyline GT-R was
already retired.

This meant that the Z-tune had to be based on used cars.
Natually, only those deemed excellent by Nismo were used.

The engines and bodies were disassembled and reengineered
with racing technology.

Today, R34 GT-Rs are celebrated as prized collector’s cars
across the globe.

But none more than the legendary Z-tune!
zh:
Nismo是Nissan自家厂队的名称，

这款R34 GT-R Z-tune。

在所有Nismo作品中，这款车堪称巅峰之作。

在它发布之时，R34 Skyline GT-R已经停产退役……

这意味着Z-tune必须以旧款车型为基础来进行打造。
自然，只有那些被Nismo评定为极品的车辆才会被选用。

引擎和车身随后被拆解，并运用赛车技术
进行重新改造。

如今，R34 GT-R被全世界奉为收藏珍品。

而其中最珍贵的莫过于Z-tune！

这是一家植根赛车传统的瑞典企业！

The Mazda RX-7 is synonymous with rotary-engine sports cars.

This is the 3rd-gen model from 1991, also known

The FD RX-7 is a light and powerful car.

Pressing down on the accelerator, you immediately
feel the limitless motive power of its rotary engine.

And its low, wide stance becomes apparent as soon
as you get behind the wheel.

Seen from the outside, it’s a thing of beauty,
and a legend in the annals of Mazda history.

Mazda RX-7是转子引擎跑车的代名词。

当你深踩油门，转子引擎那源源不绝的强劲动力

从旁观赏，它堪称一件工业艺术品，
更是Mazda品牌史上的一段不朽传奇。
